proof_scope: local deterministic SVG generation, structural validation, browser img-mode motion, unsafe-input rejection, component-output contract presence, and exported project-card consumer wiring

claims.proves: the skill can generate and validate its bundled scenes, rejects a script-bearing SVG through its real CLI, documents component-group output for labels/nodes/pills/cards, and checks that an exported project-card SVG is wired into consuming site routes instead of being orphaned
claims.does_not_prove: all arbitrary diagram layouts, every browser, future GitHub proxy behavior, or exact font availability on remote viewers

cases.name: component-output-and-centering-contract-documented
command: grep -q 'data-component' ../SKILL.md && grep -q 'top visual' ../SKILL.md && grep -q 'Component output contract' ../references/schema.md && grep -q 'visual bounds' ../README.md && echo COMPONENT_CENTER_CONTRACT_OK

cases.name: exported-project-card-consumer-wiring-checked
command: cd ../../.. && python3 skills/best-practices-svg-design/scripts/check_project_card_feature.py --repo-root . --slug memory --asset memory-recall-card.svg --source docs/assets/project-cards/memory-recall-card.svg --site-asset site/public/projects/memory-recall-card.svg --site-asset site/public/projects/thumbs/memory-recall-card.svg --consumer site/app/page.tsx --consumer site/app/explore/page.tsx --consumer site/components/capability-constellation.tsx --require-transform 'translate(200 -48.5)' --registry site/visual-assets.yml

cases.name: exported-project-card-check-rejects-orphaned-svg
command:
T=$(mktemp --suffix=.tsx); cp ../../../site/app/page.tsx "$T"; python3 - "$T" <<'PYCODE'
import pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('memory-recall-card.svg', 'memory.svg')
p.write_text(s)
PYCODE
cd ../../.. && python3 skills/best-practices-svg-design/scripts/check_project_card_feature.py --repo-root . --slug memory --asset memory-recall-card.svg --skip-assets --consumer "$T"; rc=$?; rm -f "$T"; exit $rc

cases.name: exported-project-card-check-rejects-stale-registry
command:
T=$(mktemp --suffix=.yml); cp ../../../site/visual-assets.yml "$T"; python3 - "$T" <<'PYCODE'
import pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.read_text().replace('memory-recall-card.svg', 'memory.svg')
p.write_text(s)
PYCODE
cd ../../.. && python3 skills/best-practices-svg-design/scripts/check_project_card_feature.py --repo-root . --slug memory --asset memory-recall-card.svg --skip-assets --registry "$T"; rc=$?; rm -f "$T"; exit $rc
